question: A charged particle moves in 3D space with velocity $\vec{v} = v_x \hat{i} + v_y \hat{j} + v_z \hat{k}$ in a uniform magnetic field $\vec{B} = B_0 \hat{k}$. Which of the following quantities is/are constant during the motion? (Select the most complete set).

options.B: Speed, Velocity component $v_z$, and Velocity component $v_x$.
options.C: Kinetic Energy, Speed, and Velocity component $v_z$.
